description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Amendment to the Service Minute of the Teacher Advisor's Service - Amendment No. 01
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns amendments to the Service Minute of the Teacher Advisors' Service, which is a matter of public service administration, specifically dealing with service conditions, absorption of officers, and administrative procedures. It is issued by the Public Service Commission, a body governing public sector employment. This fits the definition of Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) for public sector services and administration, including service conditions and administrative circulars.
